convention: Pass is the positive class (1); TPR = TP/(TP+FN) on human Pass, TNR = TN/(TN+FP) on human Fail
role: final test of the judge of record
selection_note: v2 became the judge of record on 2026-09-29 after the reviewer retracted v3. Sequence, stated for transparency: v3 was frozen and tested first (TPR 0.74, TNR 0.53); v2 was then frozen and scored on the same test split as a comparison (TPR 0.81, TNR 0.74); the reviewer then retracted v3 on principle (third revision beyond the cap; development gain driven by label corrections). Because v2's test run happened after v3's test result was known, this estimate is not a strictly pre-registered one, although the choice of v2 rests on the cap and the development evidence rather than on the test numbers.
decision_rationale: Reviewer decision 2026-09-29 on v2: directionally useful even though the confidence interval is wide (test TPR 0.81 [0.64, 0.91], TNR 0.74 [0.51, 0.88]; 14 of 19 failures caught). Not a gate yet: try it on a small set of requests to see whether noise, rather than the lower bound of the interval, is the real issue. v3 served only as a confirmation that high development agreement after label corrections is a smell.
